races.display_title: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: THEY'RE CHANCERS has been an infrequent visitor to the track but has looked promising when we have seen him and his pedigree points to this longer trip being within range. Hexham scorer Finisk Pride may give him most to think about. THEY'RE CHANCERS (IRE) FINISK PRIDE (IRE) WHISKEY ON ICE (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Whiskey On Ice (2/1), Finisk Pride (5/2), Gentle Ocean (3/1), They're Chancers (7/2), Blazing Court (66/1)

races.display_title: Graeme Todd Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict: Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with the lightly-raced KING HORSE taking a sizeable step forward now with Nicky Richards and capitalising on a lenient-looking mark. Tigress Lilly arrives in top form and rates a big danger though, while handicap debutant Old Comrades can also play a prominent role. KING HORSE (FR) TIGRESS LILLY OLD COMRADES (IRE)

races.verdict: A promising quartet. Expensive point recruit STICK TO THE BOARD appeals as the most likely winner following his encouraging second at Chepstow. Worcester maiden winner Black Eddy and hurdling newcomer Old Coast Road both look interesting in their own right. STICK TO THE BOARD (IRE) BLACK EDDY OLD COAST ROAD (IRE)

races.display_title: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The pick of KADASTRAL 's novice hurdle form reads well (twice second behind one who finished runner-up in Grade 1 company) and having undergone a breathing operation following his Uttoxeter disappointment in the spring, Dan Skelton's 6-y-o firmly appeals as the type to do better now his attentions switch to larger obstacles. A pace duel won't help either C&D winner Sans Bruit or Javert Allen but both are too well handicapped to ignore. Conquer The Breeze is interesting at forecast longer odds. KADASTRAL (FR) SANS BRUIT (FR) JAVERT ALLEN (FR)

races.display_title: William Hill Molyneux Hurdle (Grade 2) (Formerly Registered As The Elite Hurdle) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Successful on 2 of his first 3 starts over hurdles (excuses when second here latterly), MYDADDYPADDY found further progress and shaped a shade better than the result too when an excellent third in the Supreme at Cheltenham in March. A notably nimble jumper, he remains open to improvement and is fancied to make a winning return. Alexei did nothing but improve throughout 2025/26, including when making the frame in Grade 1s on his final 2 starts and comfortably rates the lead threat. MYDADDYPADDY (IRE) ALEXEI (GER) MANGE TOUT (FR)

races.display_title: Boodles Rising Stars Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for TALK TO THE MAN , who bettered his hurdles form at the first attempt sent chasing when winning a Worcester maiden in good style last month. He looks set to go on to better things over fences and can see off the challenge of No Drama This End , whose yard has a fine record in this race. Taurus Bay also appeals as the type to make a chaser and could be in the mix. TALK TO THE MAN (IRE) NO DRAMA THIS END (IRE) TAURUS BAY (IRE)

races.display_title: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: This looks wide open. BEAUTY CHOICE did well to overcome traffic problems when going in at Redcar recently and is taken to defy a 3 lb higher mark at the chief expense of Golden Strike who bids for a fourth victory of 2026 on the back of his latest York success. Last year's victor Lir Speciale can also have a big say too if shrugging off a lesser effort here last time. King's School completes the shortlist. BEAUTY CHOICE GOLDEN STRIKE (IRE) LIR SPECIALE (IRE)

races.verdict: It's fair to say I'M THE ONE hasn't lived up to expectations so far after her wide-margin debut win but she still sets the standard on her Cheshire Oaks form and testing conditions could well bring out the best in her (dam Group 1 winner in the mud). Felicitas looks the main threat back down in class, while Prosperity and Wadooda are both progressive. I'M THE ONE FELICITAS PROSPERITY

races.display_title: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: The exciting ALFRED WINCHAM had so much in hand at York that even a 13 lb hike doesn't look enough to stop him. 2024 winner Lord Melbourne looks to have been targeted at this again and is feared most on the back of an encouraging run at York last month. Castle Cove has been absent since winning this last year but his good record fresh means it would come as no surprise were he to go well again. The reliable Say What You See should also have a say, while Nobody Knows is the unexposed one. ALFRED WINCHAM (IRE) LORD MELBOURNE (IRE) CASTLE COVE (IRE)

races.display_title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict: KEATS HOUSE has responded well to the blinkers and is taken to resume winning ways with Rhys Elliott taking a handy 5 lb off. Titainium will be a threat if able to build on his latest back-to-form fourth at Newcastle. Billy Loughnane's mount Burford Beauty is next on the list ahead of Good Karma , who can play a part if his stamina holds back up at a 1m. KEATS HOUSE (IRE) TITAINIUM BURFORD BEAUTY (IRE)

races.verdict: This has the look of an interesting novice and it will probably go to a newcomer, with DEPUTY GENERAL and Highland Ranger arguably the most appealing pair before betting clues. races.verdict: DRISH SAMPHIRE has upped her game since the hood was removed, winning twice in her last 3 starts, including a competitive handicap at Nottingham last month where she led close home. Up The Anti has returned to form with consecutive seconds but needs things to drop right, while Masai Angel is less exposed than most of these and could go well. DRISH SAMPHIRE (IRE) UP THE ANTI (IRE) MASAI ANGEL (FR)

races.verdict: BUTTERFLY BEACH hasn't been seen since disappointing on reappearance in May but starts out for a new yard here and if she gets back to her juvenile form she'll be tough to beat. Nando Tornado showed ability along with inexperience on debut here 12 days ago and can improve, while March of Time holds claims in a race lacking in depth. races.display_title: PRL Group Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: BRADY HARTSFIELD and Huntin Boots stand out on bumper form. John McConnell's charge is preferred given the antics of the latter on his hurdling debut, while Loadstone could be the pick of the Joseph O'Brien newcomers. Baila Conmigo and Rocky Alfonso complete the shortlist. BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE) HUNTIN BOOTS (IRE) LOADSTONE (IRE)
